description: Ligon will continue to fight for conservative, common-sense policies(Chester, S.C.) – State Representative Randy Ligon today filed for re-election to represent House District 43 in the South Carolina House of Representatives. House District 43 covers most of Chester County and a portion of York County.“Serving the people of Chester and York counties is one of the greatest honors of my life. In these challenging times, I’m looking forward to getting back to work to serve our citizens,” said Ligon
